node.title: Re: Use of special character "*" to retrieve the contents
node.author: shmem
node.doctext:
See [doc://glob].

for (glob "$var1/$var2/$var3/*.ksh") { print "$_\n"; }

For portability, it is better to use [doc://File::Spec]: use File::Spec; ... my $pat = File::Spec->catfile($var1,$var2,$var3,'*.ksh'); for(glob $pat) { print "$_\n"; }

perl -le'print map{pack c,($-++?1:13)+ord}split//,ESEL'
